summary: chfast 提交 EIP-8246，移除 EIP-6780 之后仍残留的 SELFDESTRUCT 销毁 ETH 的边角情况。raulk 提交在源头批量聚合 attestation 的新 EIP。ethStaker 发布 Deposit CLI v1.3.0，支持部分存款与 Hoodi 测试网。

items.topic: 交易：EIP-8246 移除 SELFDESTRUCT 销毁
items.title: 新增 EIP-8246：移除 SELFDESTRUCT 销毁
items.note: （chfast）提交；Magicians 讨论 17:01：EIP-6780 已移除常见的销毁行为，但同一交易内创建的合约仍可通过 selfdestruct(self) 或在同一交易后续再收到 ETH 后被删除而销毁 ETH，这一情况几乎无人使用，却让客户端、规范与测试都需要特殊处理。
items.note_en: (chfast), submitted; Magicians discussion, 17:01: EIP-6780 removed the common burn behavior, but contracts created in the same transaction can still burn ETH through selfdestruct(self) or by receiving ETH later in the transaction before deletion; the case is basically unused yet forces special handling in clients, specs and tests.
items.topic_en: Transactions: EIP-8246 removes the SELFDESTRUCT burn
